entry.title: Kazarma Mycenaean Bridge

groundCutout.basis: Corbelled passage only; buried22m retaining-wing bases remain occluded by host banks.

terrainReference.basis: Original reconstructed road at southwest wing native[-11,0]; host terrain supplies bank height. Published22m extent and photographs inform relative road profile; no absolute terrain datum is assumed.

entry.note: ExactQ254087 crossing fixes north-northeast+X and east-southeast+Z. Host ground is sampled at the reconstructed southwest retaining-wing road contact11m from center, modelHeight3.386528; mid-gully DEM height is not assumed to be the threshold. The narrow terrain opening keeps the corbelled tunnel clear. Photographs establish relative bank-road/gully shape; surrounding bank profiles are reconstruction, not an elevation survey. Host terrain resolution can change exposed buried wings. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
